title: Prove QQ16’s 88-port threshold for all eight local-axis families
body:
PR2384 leaves open which ordinary read sets eliminate all eight QQ16 local-axis hidden-input families. This proves an exact criterion and sharp thresholds: **66,76,84,88 reads** for the first1,2,3,4 axes, with88 also sharp for all eight. The66 figure is credited prior work; this adds the simultaneous-axis criterion and the76/84/88 bounds.

A read set handles all eight families exactly when its unread R columns are independent. Leaving `[1,2,3,4,5,6,8,12]` unread attains88. The proof uses invariance of the source kernel under coordinate projections and their common refinement. It covers every read set; finite examples do not stand in for that argument. PR2389's credited transcript-fiber argument transfers the thresholds to exact side-effect-free adaptive readers.

Actual-owner function separation is certified by512 words of length at most4 in registered owner maps and an integer Walsh left inverse for all88 occurring bit functions. Exact mixed-input decoders attain each family bound. This remains **family-only recovery**, not a full controller, native tariff, supplier or new kappa.

Validation:

- Source-pinned routes, exact class ranks, all7744 Walsh pairs,88 boundary87-read examples and deeper-axis witnesses. The full19-event logical schedule is replayed92 times, including one repeated66-port boundary case.
- Separate certificate checker imports neither primary nor predecessor code; it reconstructs owner routes, uses direct row action and rational column-span elimination, and verifies every witness relation and nonzero selected defect.
- Registered CPython3.12 replay, nine semantic controls/boundaries and five entry-point control groups pass. A Git-free read-only24-file execution export passes under CPython3.14 with identical complete receipt and unchanged files.
- The optional deterministic certificate generator reproduces the exact certificate bytes.

Only `research/qq16-eight-axis-readsets/` is added. Existing manifest-aware package CI covers its six declared live inputs. Canonical main and all four predecessor heads were rechecked unchanged before submission.

Credit: commdata2338/PR2384 supplies the open question and retained exact logical engine; kyzer1023/PR2354 the first-axis threshold; Adam Gall/PR2093 and PR2326 the hidden-family lineage; PR2389 the adaptive argument and45-set classification; PR2419 their independent check; Ali Romman/PR1969 the QQ16 native contract. Source files and notices are retained. New work by Gareth Davidson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-assistant verification claimed.

Coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2424
Remaining: test88-read sets against other input families, or specify and fully price a changed dense-query/first-pair interface. The selected frontier is unchanged.
